design_brief: One specialist equipment silhouette; no fake live server activity in static art.
gameplay_scope: Approved passive art-library furniture only; no production/runtime binding, default-layout placement, interaction, service action, actor pose, worker authority, persistence or gameplay transaction.

current_availability.direction_art_review: Rejected after native visual inspection: v1 rendered the body as a flat frontal rectangle with only thin trim. It did not expose the physical 2x1 / 1x2 footprint as a raised top plane, so its perspective and depth contract were not acceptable. All v1 code, PNGs, manifests and evidence remain preserved as non-production history; a separate v2 must be reviewed.

previous_catalogue_availability.direction_art_review: No finished art or runtime family is claimed for this proposal; unrelated concept/source art may exist.

current_availability.rejection_reason: Missing explicit footprint-derived raised top plane and coherent camera-front elevation.

native_geometry.anchor_rule: One unchanged canvas coordinate represents local floor pivot [0,0] in every direction and every layer. Transparent padding is not sprite scaling.
native_geometry.dimension_revision: The planned maximum rise was an envelope, not required opaque height. Tall supply storage uses 112px, compact server equipment uses 96px, and the low sorter keeps 48px; original native registration and two-cell collision masks remain unchanged.

variants.redraw_requirement: Draw the actual north service front; operator approaches that side looking south. Fixed screen floor axes and upper-left light; do not rotate or mirror finished raster art. No implemented interaction is implied.
variants.reason: Rejected v1 native art: the body reads as a flat elevation and does not expose the full physical footprint as a raised top plane. Evidence and exact exports remain history only; no runtime or approval claim.
